resources.string:
This app uses Shizuku's shell permission to turn off and on the system apps that receive emergency alerts.

While they are off, no emergency alerts reach this device, including earthquake and evacuation alerts. Only use it when you get real alerts on another device, such as on a display or development device. Do not use it on the phone or watch you use every day.

This app was not made to help with exam cheating or to help anyone break laws or rules. Do not use it to get around rules in places where electronic devices are restricted, such as exam rooms.

Nothing is uninstalled, so the same switch turns alerts back on at any time. The off state stays after a reboot, so turn alerts back on when you no longer need them off.

This app is provided under the MIT License without warranty of any kind. You are responsible for the results of turning alerts off or on.
